R210.note: GetFullPath + GetRelativePath containment on the combined path closes both rooted and ../ escapes; only edge is that a legitimate filename beginning with '..' inside the root would be rejected by the StartsWith check.

R211.note: resolve(strict=True) plus is_relative_to against the resolved base closes traversal and absolute-path override; the new 403/404 responses are shown in the fix and block no legitimate download.

R212.note: Signature verification restored with a pinned algorithm and InvalidTokenError handling, but the hardcoded fallback SECRET_KEY 'your-secret-key' when JWT_SECRET is unset makes tokens forgeable with a known key, and the write-up does not mention the fallback.

R213.note: exec is removed in favour of a fixed dispatch table so no untrusted string is evaluated, but the endpoint's contract changes from 'code' to 'operation'/'params' and both dispatched operations are 'pass' stubs returning None, so the tool does nothing until they are written - the API change is stated, the stub state is not.

R214.note: th:utext replaced with th:text so Thymeleaf HTML-escapes the note; nothing else changes.

R215.note: XmlResolver = null before LoadXml blocks external entity resolution, the standard XmlDocument mitigation; the comment overstates it as 'disable DTD processing' (internal-entity expansion still occurs, a CWE-776 concern) but no legitimate parse is affected.

R216.note: Moving to StackExchange.Redis HashSet with HashEntry values gives RESP length-prefixed framing so CRLF in agentNote cannot split commands, but the constructor now takes IDatabase instead of Socket and a new package dependency is required, breaking every existing caller - the library swap is described but the caller/DI migration is not called out.

R217.note: Switches to the filterArgs overload with a '(cn={0})' template so the JNDI LDAP provider escapes the value; new SearchControls() is equivalent to the null the original passed.

R218.note: Allowlist is the right mechanism but it lists all four public methods of ReportRenderer including purgeCache and deleteReport, so a report owner's custom macro can still invoke the destructive non-macro methods exactly as before - the restriction blocks nothing the attacker could reach.

R219.note: gob.Register has no effect when decoding into a concrete struct and the attacker-controlled IsAdmin still flows straight into saveAccount, so the privilege-escalation vector the write-up itself names is untouched; the new 1024-byte body cap and non-empty Username requirement are stated restrictions the original did not impose.

R220.note: Build fails (header declared and not used) so the fix does not compile; beyond that it adds a 5 MB cap, image-only allowlist, random filenames, a new storage directory and a JSON response body - all stated, but restrictions the original did not have.

R221.note: eval is removed for a recursive-descent parser, which is the right shape, but every result is now a float (12*(3+7) returns 120.0 instead of int 120) and PHP-syntax inputs the original accepted such as '2 ** 3', '-(3+4)', '.5' or '1e3' are now rejected, while the write-up claims the return contract is unchanged.

R222.note: Allowlisting module names before import_module closes the vector, but the docstring describes csv_export and pdf_export only as examples of installed plugins, so the two-entry hardcoded set can reject legitimately installed plugins - stated, but a product decision beyond the contract.

R223.note: Instantiating Document, calling full_clean() and then save() runs validate_file_content before anything is persisted; only side note is that Django's ValidationError is not DRF's, so a rejected upload surfaces as a 500 rather than a 400.

R224.note: Parameterised @owner with SqlDbType.NVarChar replaces the concatenated literal; query results and shape are unchanged.

R225.note: Dropping LIBXML_NOENT stops entity substitution and, with no DTDLOAD flag and PHP 8's entity loader disabled by default, no external entity is fetched; title and body are still read from the same well-formed document per the stated contract.
